# Noam Tenne

> Noam Tenne is a software engineer, founder, and angel investor. He is the co-founder and CEO of Sky Valley Ambient Computing (https://skyvalley.ac), which builds infrastructure for adaptive software; its first product is Differ (https://www.getdiffer.com). He was previously a founding engineer at JFrog (Artifactory), an early engineer at Codefresh, Healthy.io, and VanMoof, and co-founder and CTO of Skippr, which was backed by investors including Bessemer Venture Partners. He invests as an angel in deep tech and healthtech. He has also published open-source work as "Noam Y. Tenne" (github.com/noamt, Maven Central).

## Pages

- [About Noam Tenne](https://noamtenne.com/): biography, career history, FAQ, and contact information.
- [Writing](https://noamtenne.com/writing/): index of essays by Noam Tenne on adaptive software, ambient computing, AI-native development, and developer infrastructure.

## Writing

Noam Tenne writes at Adaptive Software (https://adaptivesoftware.substack.com/), a publication he writes with Iris ten Teije on systems that write, heal, and personalize themselves, and previously at his personal newsletter Perihelion (https://noamtenne.substack.com/).

- [Your A/B Tests Are Limiting What Your Software Can Learn](https://adaptivesoftware.substack.com/p/your-ab-tests-are-limiting-what-your) (2026-08-19)
- [The Computer For The 21st Century, Revisited](https://adaptivesoftware.substack.com/p/the-computer-for-the-21st-century) (2026-07-14)
- [Software is a Meme, Not a Gene](https://noamtenne.substack.com/p/software-is-a-meme-not-a-gene) (2026-02-18)
- [From Requests to Promises](https://noamtenne.substack.com/p/from-requests-to-promises) (2026-02-05)
- [The End of Merge Conflicts](https://noamtenne.substack.com/p/the-end-of-merge-conflicts) (2026-02-03)
- [You Can't Command a Remote Agent](https://noamtenne.substack.com/p/you-cant-command-a-remote-agent) (2026-01-29)
